get_config_default: get the default configuration for the adult PSCF experiment with all hyperparameters set
get_config_custom_steps: get the adult PSCF config and override num_steps to a custom training step count
get_config_with_output_dir: get the adult PSCF config and set output_dir to save experiment results
get_config_with_constraint: get the adult PSCF config and enable the MMD constraint multiplier for fairness
get_config_with_seed: get the adult PSCF config and set a random seed for reproducible training
